description: Inspect the send log to verify what actually happened. With `emailId`, returns that message's status, rendered HTML (truncated), engagement counters, and any error — the way to confirm a volanea_send_test_email rendered correctly. Without it, lists recent messages, optionally filtered by recipient, status, or source (transactional/campaign/workflow/inbound) — useful to confirm a workflow actually sent its email.

emailId.description: A specific email-… id for full detail including the rendered body.

source.description: Narrow the log to one origin: a direct API send, a campaign blast, a workflow step, or mail received at an inbound address. The quickest way to answer "did my workflow actually send anything?" without wading through unrelated traffic.

status.description: Filter by delivery state. Worth knowing what these mean before trusting them: `sent` means handed to the provider, NOT that it arrived — `delivered` is the confirmation. `bounced` and `complained` also create a suppression, so that recipient is blocked from future sends. In test mode nothing leaves the building, so messages stop at `sent` and never progress to `delivered`.

to.description: Filter the list by recipient address.

name: volanea_check_delivery

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

email.description: Full detail including the rendered body, when an emailId was given.

emails.description: Matching log rows, newest first, when listing.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token — pass back verbatim to page. Never parse it.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
